summary: Form 6-K filed by Fury Gold Mines Ltd. to furnish a press release dated April 23, 2026, reporting assay results from its Phase 1 exploration drill program at the Eau Claire gold project in Quebec. The release highlights an infill drill hole intersecting 12.50 g/t gold over 7.02 m outside the current block model, demonstrating resource growth potential. No corporate transactions, board changes, or strategic reviews are discussed. This is a routine operational update for a mining issuer, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks are mentioned.
